source_review.detail: Exact frozen protocol; P3 NOPASS, P0, target diagnosis/completion, algebra/review, partition, fit GT and saved label bindings cross-checked. M/Q/N/common initialization fixed; no gate reopening.

Only streaming full native-file SHA reads uninterpreted vector bytes for identity. Bound P0 header parser seeks over payload. Numerical original-graph reads use bounded adjacency blocks only; no query/base arrays, pilot GT, validation, heldout or ANN calls.

Only -1 padding and self arcs excluded; duplicate and reciprocal original arcs retained. Other invalid IDs rejected before valid mask; in/out int64 arrays sum to M and total to 2M; P0 slot counts and partition M compared.
Int64 multiplication occurs after signed/nonnegative and overflow guards. D*9Q<M excludes equality and uses exact fixed Q=20000. No floating threshold classification.

Existing fit GT10 rehashed and row uniqueness/range checked; f(u) counts rows containing u. Three frozen label arrays rehashed and capacity/minimum/range checked. Support/max/total occurrence and final-state movement counts cross-checked against completed target diagnosis.
All 3 support, 10 exact frequency intervals and 18 movement cells retained. Changed/unchanged and frequency totals exhaust populations; occurrence weighting uses sum f(u), with zero denominator null.
Means/min/max and sparse unique-degree empirical quantiles retain exact decimal-rational ceil(p*n)-1 ranks; no interpolation or dense allocation indexed by degree maximum.

Root clarification implemented: cap covers the entire compact standalone JSON including metadata/newline; output descriptors bind path/hash/bytes and contain no duplicate pair arrays. Cap omission creates no artifact.

New exclusive output root, input/source bindings and INCOMPLETE invocation retained. Deadline checked during hash, scan and fixed groups. Datasets sequential; complete marker written only after both finished; failures preserve evidence.
Finite descriptive coverage of a sufficient condition only; no actual move replay, model selection, threshold sweep, fresh CI, router/portal/graph change or P4 authorization.

interpretation_limits: PASS applies to reviewed implementation and synthetic checks; actual full-data completion and integrity checks remain the root-controlled execution obligation.
Condition coverage does not demonstrate a feasible DeltaS-reducing candidate exists or is chosen; final label differences are not accepted-move trajectories.
No actual DeltaC/DeltaS reconstruction or causal explanation of retrieval harm follows from degree/support association.
P3 remains NOPASS; no second representation revision, P4 or auxiliary graph is authorized.
